Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite atlas, ONE square 2048x2048 PNG. EXACTLY 4 columns by 5 rows, 20 creatures, reading order left to right top to bottom. Each creature centered inside its own equal invisible cell with at least 15% WHITE empty margin on ALL FOUR SIDES. Entire appendages fit inside cell. Pure solid white background, NO ground shadows, NO labels, text, borders, grid, water, bubbles or props. Charming premium rounded 3D clay/toy collectible sea animals, subtle glossy finish, warm studio highlights from top-left, expressive dark bead eyes where anatomically appropriate, softly sculpted natural detail, refined like a cozy desktop fishing game. Full creature, three-quarter view facing RIGHT for side-profile animals. Crabs and starfish viewed from slightly above, jellyfish and shells upright. Distinct recognizable anatomy per cell, rich varied tasteful natural colors. Not pixel art, not flat vector. Uniform scale per cell. Exact row contents:
Row 1: Pacific white shrimp (pale blue translucent curved body); tiger prawn (brown black banded); northern red shrimp (rosy pink); cleaner shrimp (red white stripe and long white antennae).

Row 3: slipper lobster (flat tan shovel head); red king crab (spiny shell and long legs); snow crab (cream peach very long legs); blue swimming crab (blue pointed shell, paddle back legs).
Row 4: Chinese mitten crab is NOT wanted: draw green mud crab with thick dark jade claws; red spotted reef crab (ivory with burgundy spots); fiddler crab (one giant orange claw); porcelain crab (tiny cream blue spotted crab).
Row 5: hermit crab (orange legs emerging from spiral shell); horseshoe crab (bronze domed horseshoe shield, thin tail); Antarctic krill (tiny transparent rosy swimmer); goose barnacle cluster (three ivory plated animals on short dark flexible stalks).
